question: “Thomas Cup” is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Thomas Cup** is a prestigious **international badminton tournament **for men's teams.
 
• It was first held in **1948** and is named after** Sir George Thomas, **a former badminton player and administrator.
 
• The tournament is **held every two years **and features teams from various **countries competing** for the championship title.
 
• The Thomas Cup is considered one of the most important badminton events in the world, along with the **Uber Cup (women's teams) and the BWF World Championships (individual players).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football** is a team sport played with a ball on a** rectangular field**, where players use their feet to kick the ball into the opposing team's goal.
 
• **Cricket** is a **bat-and-ball game** played between two teams of **eleven players**, where one team bats while the other team fields and bowls.
 
• **Tennis** is an individual or doubles sport played with a **racket and a ball on a court, **where players aim to hit the ball over the net and into the opponent's court.
